# @suluk/platform

> The platform generator (C051): write one `definePlatform` manifest → it plans the shadcn-registry adds, generates the wired Hono entry, and merges each module's provision fragment into a single provision.config. The manifest compiles to a shadcn-add list + a C047 provision.config; the generator runs the adds + `@suluk/provision`. Turns the Suluk backend registry into a one-command platform. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `definePlatform`: Validate + return a platform.
- `defineSystem`: Author a SYSTEM. `const T` captures the services tuple so `serviceOpts` types resolve per service id.
- `defineBrand`: Author a BRAND.
- `isPlatform`: Discriminate the C053 `{ system, brand }` shape from the legacy manifest.
- `resolveNodeOpts`: Resolve the node quadrants of `{ system, brand }` into the `{ services, opts, vars }` a legacy manifest carries:
 - `opts[id]` (→ entry): the globa...
- `liftSystemBrand`: Lower a `{ system, brand }` platform to the legacy PlatformManifest the C051 generator renders.
- `liftLegacy`: The MIGRATE direction — a legacy PlatformManifest → the C053 `{ system, brand }` split (the inverse of
liftSystemBrand).
- `serviceId`: A ServiceRef → its runtime id (a string ref is the id; a Service object contributes `.id`).
- `resolveWiring`: Validate + compile the wires into per-producer hook fields + the imports they need.
- `groupImports`: Group wire imports by module specifier → one `import { a, b } from "x";` per module (first-seen order).
- `assertJsonSafe`: Reject non-JSON data (functions/symbols/bigint/undefined) + prototype-pollution keys anywhere in a wire's params.
- `validateIdentifier`: Guard a code IDENTIFIER (a capability symbol / import symbol) — fail closed on anything that isn't a plain identifier.
- `lit`: A schema-validated value → an inert JSON literal (never an identifier or call).
- `defineService`: Author a service.
- `optsType`: A TYPED opts marker for a service's `serviceOpts`/`brandOpts`.
- `toCatalogEntry`: Project a Service onto the legacy CatalogEntry shape the C051 generator reads.
- `orderServices`: app + auth always come first (the base + the user/apikey tables others reference); the rest keep manifest order.
- `collectEnv`: The env vars the selected services need, de-duped by name (first declaration wins).
- `resolveVersion`: Resolve a dep to its version: an @suluk/* package → "latest" (fixes flow via `bun update`); a known ecosystem dep →
 its pinned range; anything els...
- `mergeProvision`
- `planPlatform`
- `buildPackageJson`: The framework baseline package.
- `mergePackageJson`: Merge the generated framework baseline package.
- `mergeWranglerToml`: Preserve the operator's provisioned binding ids (keyed by `binding = "NAME"`) across a wrangler.toml regenerate.
- `mergeGitignore`: Merge the generated .
- `generatePlatform`
- `CORE_SERVICES`: The core services keyed by id (key === `service.id`, guaranteed by construction).
- `appService`: The 19 CORE services, expressed through the common interface (the dogfood).
- `authService`
- `contractService`
- `mcpService`
- `creditsService`
- `keysService`
- `billingService`
- `costService`
- `erasureService`
- `emailService`
- `webhooksService`
- `rateLimitService`
- `rateCreditService`
- `i18nService`
- `referenceService`
- `adminService`
- `logsService`
- `journeysService`
- `auditService`
- `CATALOG`: The offerings, derived from the core service set. `app` is the base (no mount symbol, no fragment).
- `BASE_DEPS`: The always-present framework deps (every generated app: the Effect services + Hono entry + the merged provision.
- `ECOSYSTEM_VERSIONS`: Pinned ranges for the NON-@suluk ecosystem deps — the single place they're kept current for every generated app.
- `DEV_DEPS`: The generated app's devDeps (the Workers + TS toolchain).

## Optional

### Types

- `PlatformManifest`: The C051 legacy manifest — still valid, still the byte-identity anchor.
- `SystemManifest`: A SYSTEM — the reusable, publishable template. Generic over the services tuple so `serviceOpts` is typed by service id.
- `BrandManifest`: A BRAND — thin, swappable per deployment. Carries the app identity + the brand-facing opts (→ `[vars]`).
- `Platform`: A bound platform = a system + a brand.
- `ServiceRef`: A reference to a service: an imported Service object (fully typed) or a bare string id (resolved against the
 catalog; opts typed as `unknown`).
- `WireDecl`: An inter-service composition EDGE (Phase 3).
- `Wiring`
- `WireImport`
- `Service`: THE COMMON INTERFACE.
- `Port`: A typed PORT a service EXPOSES: a named hook others fill.
- `Capability`: A typed CAPABILITY a service OFFERS to fill a port.
- `CompositionSurface`: What a service brings to the composition graph: the ports it exposes + the capabilities it offers.
- `Schema`: Standard-Schema v1 shape (zod v4 implements it).
- `McpOAuthOpts`: The MCP OAuth authorization-server config (auth's `serviceOpts.mcp`) — the frontend OAuth pages + resource + scope set.
- `AuthServiceOpts`: auth's serviceOpts: optionally activate the MCP OAuth server (Better Auth `mcp()` plugin).
- `CatalogEntry`: The old catalog record — now a DERIVED VIEW of a Service (see toCatalogEntry); kept so `planPlatform`
 and the C051 helpers read the same shape the...
- `Mount`: How a module contributes to the generated `src/index.ts`. (Unchanged from C051.)
- `EnvVar`: An env var a module (or the app's provisioning) needs — drives the generated `env.
- `PlatformPlan`
- `GenerateResult`
